CommunityApplications.Profile:
MediaMedic is a Discord-driven media repair assistant for Radarr and Sonarr. It lets trusted Discord users report broken or incorrect movie and TV files, confirm the exact managed file, blocklist a proven bad release when possible, remove it through the *arr API, trigger a replacement search, and track the replacement through download and import from a built-in Unraid Web UI.
Support and source are maintained in the MediaMedic GitHub repository.
